cohort: The study included 20 cases of conjoined twins diagnosed at a single hospital between January 2016 and December 2022.
finding: Prenatal ultrasound is the primary diagnostic tool for conjoined twins, effectively assessing the extent of twin fusion, providing critical information for clinical decision-making, and aiding in obstetric management.
mod_finding: One case of conjoined twins was successfully delivered by cesarean section at 37 weeks, leading to successful separation and recovery.
gest_age: Gestational age at diagnosis ranged from 10 to 35 weeks (average 14.21 weeks), with one delivery occurring at 37 weeks.
